name: masscan_sweep
description: Ultra-fast full port scan of an entire subnet using masscan, then service fingerprint open ports with nmap.
author: james-linux

steps.description: Masscan full 65535 port sweep at 5000 pps

params.command: grep 'open' /tmp/james_masscan.txt 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | sort -u | head -10 | while read ip; do ports=$(grep $ip /tmp/james_masscan.txt | awk '{print $3}' | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//'); echo "Scanning $ip ports $ports"; nmap -sV -p$ports $ip; done

steps.description: Service fingerprint on discovered open ports
